message: Crash between dispatch and merge_verified permanently wedged the run; patch bytes were never ledgered (only sha256), making work unrecoverable.
resolution: persistShardPatchArtifact writes captured patches under cycles/<n>/implement/shard-<id>.patch at completion; path rides claim+merge records and events/replay; reconcileStaleMergeProposals fails open proposals back to claimed with process_restart evidence on restore; runMergeBackHook rebuilds inputs from ledgered claims+artifacts when no scheduler report exists. Headless: crash after dispatch -> restore -> merge completes from ledgered patch.

message: recoverWorktrees had no production caller and prune didn't cover surviving directories; header overclaimed.
resolution: Wired into session_start; scoped reclaim of surviving harness-prefix directories with PID-marker dead-creator proof; header corrected (plain prune covers vanished dirs only).
Smoke tests 80 (flag-off no-op), 81 (HEFT order, patch-scoped staging, injected clock), 82 (conflict rejection -> claimed with taskId:null) added.
Header now: 'promoted here from src/agents/pool.ts (cleanup extracted into removeWorktree, behavior identical)'.

message: Judge rubric injection was unflagged (flag-off not prompt-identical).
resolution: GRADING RUBRIC section injected only when a custom rubric is configured; unconfigured prompts identical to pre-C4.

message: Gate part-3 snapshot recorded pre-verdict (shard counted itself).
resolution: Snapshot callback takes excludeShardId; evidence shows unverifiedShards 1 then 0 — the ledger shows the gate clearing.

message: Evaluator imported its flag from the workspace layer; lifecycle hardcoded mergeBackEnabled:true.
resolution: Evaluator reads the flag via readIterativeGoalSettings directly; lifecycle computes and passes the real flag.

message: Task-id convention duplicated as a bare string; zero matches returned null silently.
resolution: shardDispatchTaskId(cycle, shardId) in domain/shard.ts shared by scheduler and hook; enabled hook with zero matches logs.

message: Driver trusted caller-supplied rank despite reading the claims ledger.
resolution: Merge order reads the ledgered claim rank; ShardMergeInput.rank demoted to optional override. Smoke 81 + headless prove ordering from rankless inputs.

message: Default rubric duplicated the system-prompt criteria verbatim.
resolution: EVALUATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT criteria list built from DEFAULT_JUDGE_RUBRIC (single source).
recordMergeVerified takes verifiedAt? and passes it through; smoke 81 asserts the injected clock lands.
